reconstruction_policy.quest_trigger: Unique original navigation NPC, cross-checked against public giver when listed.
reconstruction_policy.eligibility: One completion per delivery mission; original parent and explicit minimum, with displayed level as a conservative minimum. These eligibility defaults are reconstructed, not exported server conditions.
reconstruction_policy.unused_reward_columns: Legacy private-server tracking metadata initialized to zero; ignored by the runtime loader.
reconstruction_policy.rt_soul: Original type-9 rewards are retained, but the inherited native and .NET quest handlers do not implement them.
reconstruction_policy.routes: Original terrain-unit IDs, assigned to this single local server/channel.
reconstruction_policy.monsters: No monster is spawned from a quest guidance marker. Markers do not specify original population, variants, heights for every spawn, timers or drops.
